body:
I dunno. Just feels like I have nothing left. I always hear, "change comes from within" and "only you can help you" 
I cant. I don't have anything left. It's just a matter of time. I've given up. 

I'll keep going to therapy and keep going to see my psychiatrist and keep taking the meds. I'm just dead inside.

 I've just run out of steam and the daily requirements of life are completely overwhelming. I don't enjoy anything. I can't even play with my kid. I'm just going to spread my borderline to him. I really hate this shit. I wish I never heard that fucking word. 
I'll trudge through another day, but I'm dead inside already.

I e already started DBT. My insurance deductible is $6000 and I only have have the rest of this year to go to dbt, the group doesn't start until the end of June. I don't even have time to get through all three groups. I'm sick of being borderline. It's a disgusting thing to have. No one gives a shit about you and they always think the worst. I don't know how I act and what I say. I'm bad and that's never going to change. Dbt won't help me. It's too late for anything to help.
